_comment: Provenance for WASM bundles built from the pqctoday-hsm repo and vendored into this hub. When you rebuild a bundle with its hsm build script, update its `hsmCommit`/`builtAt`. Verify drift with `npm run sync:wasm:check` (compares against a sibling ../pqctoday-hsm checkout when present; no-op otherwise). Bundles built from other sources (openssl upstream, pqctoday-tpm) are intentionally omitted.

bundles.name: cacp-kmip
bundles._buildNote: FrodoKEM (6 variants) + Classic McEliece-6688128 (BSI TR-02102-1), fully wired end to end: engine, KMIP ops, raw PKCS#11 C-ABI, and the hub's own algorithm picker/TTLV encoder (alg_from_name bare-name fallback, kmipMeta.ts RUNNABLE_EXACT, codepointTable.ts CryptographicAlgorithm patches). Also required bumping build-kmip-wasm.sh's wasm32 stack size to 8MiB: FrodoKEM-1344's matrix generation overflowed the ~1MiB default even in --release. hsmCommit is pqctoday-hsm PR #131's merge commit on main (built from the branch tip just before merge; PR #131 also fixed a native test-thread stack overflow and a PKCS#11 constants-gate gap — neither touches this bundle's compiled output).

bundles.name: softhsmrustv3-engine
bundles._buildNote: Rebuilt to pick up FrodoKEM/Classic McEliece-6688128 on the raw PKCS#11 C-ABI (C_GenerateKeyPair/C_EncapsulateKey/C_DecapsulateKey) plus a large amount of accumulated PKCS#11 v3.2 surface added since the last build (2026-06-27, e912488): C_GetInterface/C_GetInterfaceList, C_LoginUser, C_SetPIN, C_SessionCancel, message-based sign/verify, and more — this bundle had drifted well behind the engine. Still built with --features acvp (required since 2026-06-27: C_Initialize rejects non-null pReserved without it, breaking ACVP KAT seeding).

bundles.name: softhsm-cpp-engine
bundles._buildNote: Includes fix(cpp) 250994d: SP800-108 KDF now requires keyed-MAC PRF (CKM_SHA256_HMAC); bare hash IDs rejected per PKCS#11 v3.2 §6.42.
